description:
FILED s398 (Fable, #153 FOLD chunk 3 review probes; occurs in NO population — filler).  PRE-EXISTING: identical on main (13bcef4) and on the chunk-3 branch, so not a fold regression.

PROBED vs perl 5.40.3 (scratchpad probes/fat.pl):
    package Foo; sub x { "X" }  package main;
    my %h = (Foo->x => 1); print join(",", %h), "|\n";     perl: X,1|    PCL: |      (SILENT WRONG)
    my @l = (Foo->x => 1); print "@l|\n";                  perl: X 1|    PCL: |      (SILENT WRONG)
    my %g = (Foo->x, 1);  print join(",", %g), "|\n";      perl: X,1|    PCL: X,1|   (plain comma: fine)

CAUSE: the fat-comma autoquote rewrite in PExpr cleanup_for_parsing (the site DECIDED s374/#234 names) turns the Word `x` into a Quote::Double "x" WITHOUT looking at the token before it; after `->` that word is a METHOD NAME, and perl calls it (perl: the identifier after -> is lexed as a method, `=>` autoquote does not apply).  The arrow machinery then meets `-> "x"` and the expression parse dies "unhandled postfix -> term", which _parse_expression_form swallows into `(progn ;; PARSE ERROR: … nil)` — the whole statement lowers to nil (the #138/#259 silent-drop family; #259 asks who owns making that path die).

FIX SHAPE (CLAUDE.md 11 — one predicate at the existing site): in the fat-comma rewrite, skip a Word whose previous significant token is the arrow operator `->` (a method name is never an autoquote candidate).  Check the sibling autoquote sites named in DECIDED s374 (`_subscript_autoquote_text`, the interpolation key regex) do not have the same blindness — `$h{$o->x}` is a subscript EXPRESSION not a bareword key, so they should already be fine; probe.  Guard rows: the two silent-wrong shapes above + INVERSE `(x => 1)` and `(Foo::x => 1)` still autoquote (probe vs perl first — s374 rule).  BAR: corpus-diff (expect identical), gate.
subject: SILENT WRONG: a method name directly before a fat comma is autoquoted — `Foo->x => 1` becomes `Foo->"x"`, a PARSE ERROR comment, empty value
